subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: After the persistence checkpoint is fixed, should OpenClaw retain both the new opt-in maintenance-timeout config key and the generic synchronous command-queue timeout callback?
rationale: The persistence defect has a narrow mechanical repair, but the config key and shared queue callback are lasting compatibility and API choices that require owner intent.

options.title: Accept Both Contracts
options.body: Keep the opt-in config key and generic callback after adding the missing cross-storage persistence checkpoint and regression proof.

options.title: Narrow The Surfaces
options.body: Reuse existing timeout policy and keep timeout fencing private to the context-engine maintenance lifecycle.

options.title: Pause The Design
options.body: Delay or close the branch until owners define a different canonical cancellation and persistence-ownership contract.

recommendation.title: Accept Both Contracts
recommendation.body: Keep the opt-in config key and generic callback after adding the missing cross-storage persistence checkpoint and regression proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and merged the current dedicated maintenance-lane behavior and has recent history in the transcript rewrite owner boundary.
